error[ZBX-E0568]: the identity may not read the repository, or it does not exist
  cause  us-docker.pkg.dev denied the pull of zbx-demo/zbx-denied/hello: the
         identity lacks artifactregistry.repositories.downloadArtifacts, or the
         repository does not exist
  host   us-docker.pkg.dev
  repo   zbx-demo/zbx-denied/hello
  perm   artifactregistry.repositories.downloadArtifacts
  fix    grant roles/artifactregistry.reader on the repository to the identity
         and check the repository's name and region
  more   zbx explain E0568
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0568.html
